captions.detailed: A dark iron swivel cannon mounted on a vertical support post. The assembly features a cylindrical base post rising from a circular flange, topped with a rectangular forked yoke. The cannon barrel is suspended between the yoke's vertical arms. The barrel can rotate horizontally (yaw) on a continuous joint around the post axis, and it can tilt vertically (pitch) on a revolute joint via the pivot pins in the yoke.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a dark iron swivel cannon mounted on a vertical post. The post should have a circular base, a vertical cylindrical shaft, and a rectangular forked yoke at the top that holds the main cannon barrel on a horizontal pivot axis to allow vertical elevation.
captions.factory: The code constructs the model using cylindrical primitives for the base flange, the main vertical support shaft, and the stepped sections of the cannon barrel. The forked yoke is created using a combination of box primitives for the base and vertical side plates, joined with cylindrical pins. A sphere is used to model the rear breech cap of the barrel, and all components are assembled with appropriate relative transformations to establish the pivot geometry.
